PAGE TITLE: MANAGEMENT’S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS WELCOME TO NASA / NASA by the Numbers

  - Chart Type: Breakdown list / summary cards

  - Categories and Values:
    - Research, Engineering, & Development: $13.3B (54%)

    - Johnson Space Center (JSC): 3,229 (18%)

PHOTOS:
- Photo showing a dark textured background with the NASA logo and text reading "2024 ONWARD AND UPWARD".
- Caption/Text: "Landing science on the Moon, demonstrating quiet supersonic aircraft, and launching two new Earth climate satellites, plus a mission to Europa, one of Jupiter's icy moons, are just a FEW of the milestones we have planned for 2024. (December 27, 2023)".

KEY FACTS:
- FY 2024 budget: $24.9 billion
- Research, Engineering, & Development budget: $13.3 billion (54%)
- Operations budget: $9.0 billion (36%)
- Grants budget: $1.3 billion (5%)
- Facilities and Equipment budget: $1.3 billion (5%)
- The $24.9 billion includes $4.5 million of funds transferred from General Services Administration (GSA) for Technology Modernization Fund (TMF) investment award.
- NASA's civil service workforce: 18,475 employees
